title_vi: Kafka nhập môn: theo bảy đơn hàng đi qua một cụm ba máy

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a partial clone of the source repository; git hash-object of the retrieved body matches the source-map blob. No source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Kafka là kiểu hệ thống tin nhắn giữ tin trong nhật ký.
Kafka có thể làm mất tin ở đâu.

claims.evidence: The Kafka introduction and design pages were read from a partial clone of apache/kafka (trunk) and librdkafka CONFIGURATION.md from a partial clone of confluentinc/librdkafka; the topic layout, partitions, offsets, leaders and group assignment come from the author's run on a three-broker Kafka 4.4.0 cluster (one machine, KRaft) with confluent-kafka 2.16.0 on 2026-10-18.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered lesson.md (markdown-it, tables enabled, every <details> open, a 16 px page gutter) at each width: the page never scrolled sideways and the figure was scaled to the column; the smallest SVG font-size times that scale is the recorded minimum at 320 px. `python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser` measured every line of the figure in Chromium inside its box. Not GitHub, not a real phone and not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: An event has a key, value, timestamp and optional headers; topics are partitioned across brokers; events with the same key go to the same partition and a partition is read in write order; events are not deleted after consumption but retained per topic; a replication factor of 3 is a common production setting.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of apache/kafka at commit 65566690ca1ddb584388c1026e2ff6673e9c6f19.

claims.claim_vi: Each partition is consumed by exactly one consumer within each subscribing consumer group at any given time; each partition has one leader and zero or more followers and all writes go to the leader.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of apache/kafka at commit 65566690ca1ddb584388c1026e2ff6673e9c6f19.

claims.claim_vi: librdkafka's default partitioner is consistent_random (CRC32 hash of the key); murmur2_random is functionally equivalent to the Java producer's default partitioner.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of confluentinc/librdkafka at commit 8c03f75a31ca61d08b2cc2ddc5b233b80d14bdad.

claims.claim_vi: Measured on Kafka 4.4.0 with three brokers, topic orders with 3 partitions and replication factor 3: leaders were brokers 2, 3, 1 for partitions 0, 1, 2; keys an and binh went to partition 2 (offsets 0 to 4), chi to partition 0 (offsets 0, 1), partition 1 got nothing; group billing with two members was assigned [0,1] and [2] and read 2 and 5 events; group email with one member was assigned all three and read 7.
claims.verified_by: The author ran and measured this on 2026-10-18; the Kafka 4.4.0 archive was checked against its published SHA-512.

claims.claim_vi: Kafka 101 in eight steps: what Kafka is, messages, topics and partitions, advantages, producer, consumer, cluster and use cases.

When the partition count of a topic increases, the default partitioner's hash(key) % number_of_partitions mapping changes, so messages with the same key may go to different partitions after the expansion, affecting ordering for existing keys; Kafka does not redistribute existing data.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of apache/kafka at commit 65566690ca1ddb584388c1026e2ff6673e9c6f19.

design_notes_vi: Bốn bước của một sự kiện, hai nhóm đọc với phân công partition thật từ thử nghiệm, ba điều nên nhớ. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: The source defines eight concepts in turn; the lesson builds them from one experiment and adds that ordering holds only within a partition and that partitions cap the useful members of a group.
The lesson omits the source's company names and its list of use cases.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
